description:
Create accessible PDF documents directly from Microsoft PowerPoint.

axesSlide is a Microsoft PowerPoint add-in that converts presentations into accessible PDFs that meet PDF/UA and WCAG requirements.
New features
- Embedded fonts: Fonts embedded in the presentation are now supported.
- Prefer cloud fonts: A new toggle lets you specify whether Microsoft 365 cloud fonts are preferred over locally installed fonts. For more information refer to Choose fonts for the PDF export.
Improvements
- Links that are split into several parts in the presentation are now merged into a single link.
- The License Manager has been updated to .NET 10.
Bug fixes
- Under certain circumstances, the license manager was not updated correctly.
- General bug fixes.
